text: $QNT’s on fire – up 74% to $175, swinging from $99 to $195 in 24 h, volume over $80 M. Meanwhile $XRP slipped 1.7% to $1.53, barely budging between $1.50 and $1.56 despite $175 M of trades. $RUNE managed a modest 15.8% gain, sitting at $0.792 after topping out at $0.845. Leaders are roaring, laggards are just edging down. Looks like the upside is doing the heavy lifting while the rest stays flat.
